notes.title: Galaxy Crash 1.0 is Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick announcement that Galaxy Crash 1.0 is now out and purchasable via steam!

Thank you to all of our Kickstarter backers and friends who have helped test the game before release and help make it a better game!

Thank you to everyone who has supported me over development. It has been a truly humbling experience.

Thank you all and I hope you enjoy the game!
Lewis
